public_brief.objective: Explain away the tub before the guest draws conclusions.

public_brief.mirror: steady energy, standard, dry humor: let the objects speak, the dealer smooths it over

segments.speaker: Narrator
segments.text: Nik crouches at the lip of the tub. It holds no water: someone has made a bed of it. A bedroll lies along the bottom, a roll of thieves' tools beside it, and a bundle of travel gear. Poking from it is a coil of rope with someone else's initials burned into the end.

segments.speaker: Dealer
segments.text: Ah. Our storeroom. Travelers leave such things behind, little scholar, in their haste to be elsewhere. We keep them safe in case they ever come back. Nobody has come back yet. Shall we leave the poor tub in peace and deal you a hand?
